purpose: Development smoke validation, not a confirmatory performance benchmark
fixture_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 of initial manifest JSON with sorted keys and compact separators; manifest includes SHA-256 for all initial files.
prompt_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 of protected TASK.md bytes, common across A/B/C tiny runs.
skill_hash_algorithm: For sorted relative file paths in the skill tree: update SHA-256 with path UTF-8 bytes + NUL + file bytes + NUL.
arm_instruction_hashes: Not retained; null. Summaries are not verbatim control prompts.
root_model: All trial roots used inherited model selection in this hosted session; no root model override. Runtime model build and backend attestation unavailable.
worker_model: Native spawn requests explicitly selected gpt-6.1-terra for the four B/parallel-C workers and were accepted. Not a backend attestation.
isolation: Fresh agent contexts and separate workspace directories on a shared filesystem. No enforced OS isolation from siblings or hidden tests.
order: Development order; not randomized, balanced, or blinded.
pilot_deviations: Parallel C explicitly requested native workers, so it tests execution and integration, not autonomous choice to parallelize.
Dependency task wording corrected before its scored trial; original ambiguous directory was not run/scored.
Preliminary tiny C smoke run passed before the final frozen-skill rerun; excluded from primary six-run table, retained as development history.
No tokens, billing, comparable end-to-end timing, complete event export, enforced total resource budget or measured peak concurrency.
grader_timing: elapsed_seconds is only the post-trial hidden-check subprocess time; it is not agent or task latency.
nonclaims: No estimate of relative speed, cost, success probability, scalability or production reliability.
Grader results do not establish hostile-code security, full requirement coverage or resource-limit compliance.
No executed worker-failure injection, cancellation race, recovery-loop or destructive-operation tests.
